claim: Data on NVMe instance storage is encrypted with an XTS-AES-256 block cipher in a hardware module on the instance; the keys are unique per device, destroyed when the instance stops or terminates, and you cannot disable this encryption or supply your own key.
question: How is data on NVMe instance store volumes encrypted, and can you control the key?

values.spoken: XTS AES two fifty-six block cipher

evidence.quote: The data on NVMe instance storage is encrypted using an XTS-AES-256 block cipher implemented in a hardware module on the instance. The encryption keys are generated using the hardware module and are unique to each NVMe instance storage device. All encryption keys are destroyed when the instance is stopped or terminated and cannot be recovered. You cannot disable this encryption and you cannot provide your own encryption key.
